caption: The drawing depicts the handle of a cane or staff shaped like a horse's head. The horse head is rendered in shades of gray with dark crack-like lines running throughout, suggesting it is made from a material such as aged ivory or stone. The horse has ears pricked forward, a prominent eye, and a slightly open mouth holding a metallic ring. The handle beneath the horse's head is cylindrical and colored in dark green with irregular patches and cracks, accented by rusty red and brown hues. The object is vertically centered within a rectangular border, with the artist’s name, "Vincent P. Rösel," and the date “390-1” written in small text at the bottom right corner outside the border. The background is plain and off-white, with faint discolorations and spots.
title: Horse Head Hitching Post
